	aptitude = {

		add = {

			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_learning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = zealous }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_zealous_trait
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value

	valid_position = {
		is_roman_emperor_trigger = yes
		LR_is_graeco_roman_pagan_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			base_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege }
			is_male = yes
			is_adult = yes
			LR_is_graeco_roman_pagan_trigger = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = LR_flamen_married_tt
				is_married = yes
				primary_spouse ?= { LR_is_graeco_roman_pagan_trigger = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { scope:liege = { has_treasury = no } }
				add = minor_court_position_salary
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes } }
				add = minor_court_position_salary
			}
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = minor_court_position_salary
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.02
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.04
		}
		average = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.06
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.03
		}
		good = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.08
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.05
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.1
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.08
			vassal_opinion = 3
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		general_opinion = 10
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
		scope:employee.primary_spouse ?= { add_character_modifier = LR_flaminica_dialis_modifier }
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
		scope:employee ?= { every_spouse = { remove_character_modifier = LR_flaminica_dialis_modifier } }
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
		scope:employee ?= { every_spouse = { remove_character_modifier = LR_flaminica_dialis_modifier } }

			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = LR_flamen_dialis_court_position

		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
